name: smart-erp
description: Smart ERP — multi-tenant business management system (Angular + Express + MongoDB)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,api,web -c magenta,cyan,green "npm run dev -w @erp/shared" "npm run dev -w @erp/api" "npm run start -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @erp/shared && npm run build -w @erp/api && npm run build -w web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @erp/shared && npm run test -w @erp/api && npm run test -w web -- --watch=false
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @erp/shared && npm run typecheck -w @erp/api
